tests.description: startup prints one line for a server that needs a login and one for a failed server, and none for a connected one
tests.expectedOutput: "MCP: linear needs you to log in. Type /mcp to log in.|MCP: github failed to connect: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:3000"

tests.description: an old package gives one startup line with the upgrade command
tests.expectedOutput: "MCP: @agency-lang/mcp 0.0.5 is too old. Run: npm install -g @agency-lang/mcp@latest"

tests.description: a project server wins over a global one of the same name, and a server with no state is not connected
a state for a server that is no longer in the config gets no row
each status becomes the sentence the user sees
tests.expectedOutput: "✔ s connected · 2 tools. You can use them from your next message.|s needs you to log in.|s failed to connect: boom"

tests.description: the server list starts with Back, and a server's label is its status alone, since the picker already shows its name
each kind of row offers its actions in order
a finished login adds the server's tools to the session
when opening the browser is rejected, the login URL is still shown
an approved log out removes the server's tools
a rejected mcp::logout keeps the login and the tools
a login that is started and never finished does not block a login to another server
Connect on a server that was never connected connects it
tests.expectedOutput: "✔ t7 connected · 1 tool. You can use them from your next message."

tests.description: a login that cannot start says why and does not wait
tests.expectedOutput: "t10: t10 is not an OAuth server"

tests.description: a reconnect that fails gives the reason
tests.expectedOutput: "t8 failed to connect: spawn missing ENOENT"

tests.description: opening the menu disconnects a server that is no longer in the config, and the next turn does not connect it again
a server added to the config since startup connects on the next turn
startup only stores the config, and the first turn connects the stored servers
a stdio server whose start is refused is asked about once, not on every turn
no Agency global holds the MCP tools, so a restore keeps the tools of a login made after the checkpoint
